prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1123; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle drifted into their lane on the highway. Insured vehicle sustained right rear quarter panel damage. Claimant reports neck and shoulder pain at the scene and was evaluated by paramedics. Police report requested.

Entry 2: Recorded statement obtained from insured. Insured states they signaled and checked mirrors before merging. Claimant vehicle identified and contact information confirmed. Claimant is not represented by an attorney at this time. Photos of both vehicles received and added to file.

Entry 3: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant reports right shoulder injury with limited range of motion and is scheduled for an orthopedic evaluation. Claimant asked about the claims process and was advised of the right to seek counsel if desired. Medical authorization forms sent to claimant for signature.

Entry 4: Police report received. Report notes the other driver was cited for failure to maintain lane. Independent appraiser assigned to inspect the insured vehicle. Rental car coverage confirmed for the insured while repairs are pending. Claimant's treating provider contacted to request preliminary records.

Entry 5: Medical records received showing diagnosis of right rotator cuff strain with recommendation for physical therapy. Bodily injury evaluation opened and claimant notified of the status. Repair estimate reviewed and approved for the insured vehicle. File remains open pending completion of treatment and final medical documentation.
